## About
At Latondress Auto World, we are dedicated to providing professional customer service and quality automotive services to the community. Whether your car needs engine repair or just an oil change, our goal is honest, quality service in a timely manner.
Customers know us by name. One reviewer calls the owner Jeff and mechanic Derek top notch, and another says brothers Eric and Derek could not have been more patient, transparent, competent, and kind. One customer, a Navy veteran, recommends Jeff to the vets he talks to at the VA.

## Services
- AC / Heater Repair: Keeping your car comfortable whether it's hot or cold out.
- Brakes: Brake work done right. One reviewer had us rebuild his entire brake system.
- Shocks and Struts: Suspension repair, including strut replacement.
- Alternators & Starters: Help when your car won't start or your battery keeps dying.
- Belts & Hoses: Replacing worn belts and hoses.
- Electrical Diagnosing & Repair: Tracking down electrical problems and fixing them.
- Engine repair: From engine repair to a simple oil change.

## FAQ
Q: Who will be working on my car?
A: The shop is run by owner Jeff, and reviewers mention mechanics Eric and Derek by name.

Q: Do you handle small jobs like oil changes?
A: Yes. Whether your car needs engine repair or just an oil change, we'll take care of it.

Q: Can I bring my car in for a second opinion?
A: One reviewer did just that after getting a quote elsewhere, and she says Eric and Derek were patient and transparent with her.
